description:
Use this when the user wants the picture framed differently in a clip or photo: "zoom in a bit", "show more
        of the left", "mirror it", "show the whole picture", "a black background, not the blur", "make it
        1200 by 628". clip_id: from list_clips (kind photo for photos). zoom 1-4 (1 = no zoom); position_x and
        position_y 0-100, where the frame sits over the picture (0 = left / top, 50 = center); flip_horizontal,
        flip_vertical; fit: fill (fills the frame, edges cropped), whole (the whole picture with background around
        it) or a band shape 4:3, 1:1, 16:9, 9:16; background: blur or a color name or hex; blur_amount 1-120;
        custom_width with custom_height (240-4096 px) for a custom size.
        Not for: the standard shapes 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 (style_clip output_shape), light and color (adjust_look) or
        a facecam split (edit_clip). Rotation is done in the RipClip editor. Saved as an undoable version (undo_edit).
        Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then preview_frame.
name: frame_clip
title: Frame a clip or photo
